definitions: An act of blushing; a pink or red glow on the face caused by embarrassment, shame, shyness, love, etc.
A glow; a flush of colour, especially pink or red.
To become red or pink in the face (and sometimes experience an associated feeling of warmth), especially due to shyness, love, shame, excitement, or embarrassment.
To be shy, ashamed, or embarrassed (to do something).
The inherent nature of a thing or idea.
The true nature of anything, not accidental or illusory.

blocks.text: Essence has various meanings and uses for different thinkers and in different contexts. It is used in philosophy and theology as a designation for the property or set of properties or attributes that make an entity the entity it is or, expressed negatively, without which it would lose its identity. Essence is contrasted with accident, which is a property or attribute the entity has accidentally or contingently, but upon which its identity does not depend.
Blush is a medium bright tone of pink.
